support_files: tests/support/render_bvh/sdf_scene.rs (<=450; split sdf_compare.rs if it approaches 500)

expected_renders.per_camera: 2 cameras per group (cam-front 320x240 = 76800 px, cam-top 240x180 = 43200 px, total 120000 px)
expected_renders.shadow_arm: sdf-mesh, cam-front, shadows on vs off (consistency only, no upstream reference)
expected_renders.depth_seg_cross_path: sdf-mesh, cam-front, DepthSeg path vs megakernel depth/seg (bitwise)

criteria.determinism: two-run rgb/depth/seg sha256 equal (per entity, same context)
criteria.shadow_arm: consistency only (no upstream shadow-off reference, Chief 2026-10-31): depth/seg bitwise equal between shadows on/off; rgb shadow_off >= shadow_on per channel with reversed pixels beyond 1 LSB == 0; changed pixels > 0; both arms two-run sha equal; no numerical reference claim
criteria.depth_seg_cross_path: DepthSeg path depth/seg bitwise equal to megakernel depth/seg for the same input (sdf-mesh, cam-front); if the product API cannot expose both paths, fall back to a single-path launch comparison, criteria unchanged
criteria.reference: no new references: reuse fixtures/render-bvh/scene-sdf/capture-sdf/{sdf-mesh,sdf-occluder} (U3 capture products)

guards.input_breakdown: scene-sdf 10 (2 XML + 8 capture products) + scene-hfield 10 (2 XML + 8 capture) + legacy 47 (38 base + 4 skybox + 5 perworld) + scene-shadow capture 16
guards.aggregate: generated at freeze; not preset by the material
guards.note: the freeze script hard-asserts 9/83/92 and throws on mismatch; U1/U1b change product code so every exe hash differs and no historical guards may be reused

window.shell: Windows PowerShell 5.1 (aggregate_sha256 uses culture-sensitive Sort-Object; pwsh 7 differs)
window.mode: regular util<40, NO exception; the authoring-only util<60 exception does NOT apply to this window

baseline_sop.snapshot: 5 min before monitor: nvidia-smi free/util x3 (~1 s apart) + compute-apps raw/filtered + build processes (must be 0) + git clean
baseline_sop.abort: free_min < floor_mib or used delta > 3072 MiB or external compute load or build process appears
baseline_sop.monitor_clean: free >= 10240 MiB AND util < 40 AND filtered compute-apps = 0 AND build = 0 (monitor defaults, no -MaxUtil override)

window.failure_policy: STOP on any failure; no retry loop, no threshold change, no exception substitution, no criteria relaxation; keep the attempt directory; attempt=2 only after a documented fix

evidence.hygiene: LF no BOM; forbidden claim terms absent
